_comment: Per-player MAX-exposure overrides for the 20-entry GPP build (gpp20). Value = max fraction of the lineup set a player may appear in (0-1). Overrides the global/conviction cap in EITHER direction: 0.80 lets a smash spot go overweight, 0.10 fades a player. Example: "nfl": {"Christian McCaffrey": 0.80}. MINIMUMS: use an object, e.g. "nfl": {"Christian McCaffrey": {"min": 0.40, "max": 0.80}} -- mins are filled first (forced in by a direct solve if needed); applies to the 20-max and Large builds. Others keep the computed cap. Name matching is order-insensitive (First Last or Last, First both work). Edit weekly for injuries/news; delete an entry to remove the cap.
